reason: 该插件的主要用途是为 DeepSeek Harness 提供“插件管理”设置页，面向用户进行 MCP 服务、Skills 与已装插件的可视化治理（查看、开关、删除/回收）和内置包只读浏览。依据仓库说明与清单可见其能力集中在本地 DSH 运行配置与目录编辑，并通过内嵌后端 API 提供状态查询与变更执行，属于插件开发/运维工具性质，而非内容创作或研究类插件。

summaries.zh: 这是一个集成在 DeepSeek Harness 设置面板中的插件管理器，支持可视化查看与操作 MCP、Skills 及已安装插件，并提供开关、删除和可恢复的回收站流程。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness settings-panel plugin manager that provides a visual workflow to manage MCP services, Skills, and installed plugins, including toggling, deletion, and recoverable trash-based removal steps.

capabilities: Local read/write operations on DSH profile and plugin config files (for example cordis.patch.yml and profile package.json).
Enable/disable MCP services and installed plugins by updating runtime patch/config state.
Delete operations can move skill and plugin data to trash locations and alter installed plugin state.
Exposes same-origin API routes for state retrieval and action execution within the DSH web host.

reasons.code: README documents plugin-management operations (MCP/skill/plugin enable, disable, delete) and real-time hot-apply behavior.
README describes API endpoints /plugin-manager/api/state and /plugin-manager/api/action used to read state and apply kinds such as mcp-toggle, skill-delete, plugin-delete.
README states write operations modify ~/.dsh paths including cordis.patch.yml and profile package.json with .bak backups before edits.
package.json declares this package as a DSH web plugin with bundle patch and client inject configuration.
